title: Tissot indicatrix for location encoders: Characterizing local distortion in learned geographic embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.29249v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the increasing adoption of geographic artificial intelligence, location encoders are widely used to map geographic coordinates to learned embeddings for tasks in Earth observation and geospatial modeling. Similar to map projections, location encoders can distort geographic space, that is, equal-distance displacements in different directions can result in unequal embedding changes. However, such distortion remains largely unexamined, and it can propagate into downstream applications. We adapt Tissot's indicatrix, a cartographic tool for map projection distortion, to characterize this distortion. At each location, we compare encoder outputs at equal distances in 32 directions and fit a tensor, represented by an ellipse, whose elongation (anisotropy) and orientation describe the local distortion. The fit requires only encoder outputs without access to model internals and is validated against references with known geometry. By applyin

translated_title: 用于位置编码器的蒂索指标：表征学习型地理嵌入中的局部畸变
translated_abstract: 随着地理人工智能的日益普及，位置编码器被广泛用于将地理坐标映射为学习到的嵌入向量，以支持地球观测和地理空间建模等任务。与地图投影类似，位置编码器可能会使地理空间发生畸变，即不同方向上等距离的位移会导致不相等的嵌入变化。然而，这种畸变在很大程度上尚未被研究，并且可能会传播到下游应用中。我们改造了蒂索指标——一种用于刻画地图投影畸变的制图学工具——来表征这种畸变。在每个位置上，我们比较编码器在32个方向上等距离处的输出，并拟合一个张量（用一个椭圆表示），其拉伸程度（各向异性）和方向描述了局部畸变。该拟合仅需要编码器的输出，无需访问模型内部结构，并通过与具有已知几何特性的参考进行对比得到了验证。
tldr: 本文将制图学中的蒂索指标创新性地应用于位置编码器，仅通过编码器输出（无需访问模型内部）拟合椭圆张量，从而量化和刻画学习型地理嵌入中的局部各向异性畸变。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts the cartographic Tissot indicatrix to location encoders, characterizing local anisotropic distortion in learned geographic embeddings by fitting an ellipse tensor from encoder outputs alone, without requiring access to model internals.
